prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in while turning left in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: [Claimant name]. I'd rather just get to the point.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection?

A: I was turning left off the main road into the shopping center. The light had changed to green, and I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic. A pickup coming the other way was going pretty fast, and I thought I had time. Then he hit the passenger side of my car.

Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred, or had you stopped?

A: I was almost through the turn. Maybe a few miles an hour, nothing dramatic.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started the turn?

A: I saw headlights, but I didn't think it was close enough to be a problem. I should have waited longer, I guess.

Q: Did you or anyone else in your vehicle require medical attention at the scene?

A: Not at the scene. I felt fine right away, but by that evening my lower back was really tight and sore. I went to urgent care the next morning.

Q: Can you describe the pain you are currently experiencing?

A: It's a strain-type ache in the lower back, worse when I bend or sit for long periods. Some stiffness in the mornings. My doctor has me on physical therapy and light duty at work for now.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I want this handled fairly, and I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
